p: {name} shows Google AdMob ads in two formats only. A rewarded video is always your choice: you can watch one for free coins, an extra daily spin, or a dice re-roll. A banner sits at the bottom of the game screen in matches against the computer; there is no banner in Pass and Play. There are no full-screen ads between games.

AdMob may collect and use the advertising ID, device and app information, approximate location from the IP address, ad interactions, and its own diagnostics, to serve, measure and limit ads, and to prevent fraud. See how Google uses information from apps that use its services. You can reset or delete the advertising ID in your phone's Google settings.

Google Play builds of {name} include Firebase Analytics. It receives anonymous usage events (screens opened, game start and end, rewards claimed) together with an app-instance ID and basic device information. Your name, photo, gender and coin balance are not sent. A copy built without a Firebase configuration sends nothing to Firebase.

When the phone is online, the app asks two public time services, worldtimeapi.org and timeapi.io, for the current India date so daily rewards reset at midnight IST. Those requests do not include your name, photo, or coin balance. Like any web request they see the phone's IP address. If the phone is offline, the app uses the device clock and blocks a claim when that clock has been moved backwards.

Reminders are off until you turn them on and allow notifications. The app then schedules at most one local reminder a day, around 7 pm phone time, and only while you are away from the game. The reminder is made and shown on this phone. Nothing is sent to a push server. You can turn reminders off in the app at any time.

Play vs AI is played against computer opponents on the phone, and each one is labelled AI. Choosing a photo opens the system picker. The app does not ask for camera or photo library permission. Vibration uses the normal vibrate permission and only runs when that setting is on. The share button opens your phone's share sheet. The app does not receive the list of people you share with.

p: {name} shows Google AdMob ads in two formats only. A rewarded video is always your choice, for example to continue a game, double coins, get one extra spin a day, or use a helper (power-up): rotate, swap tray or undo. A banner is shown on the game screen only. There are no full-screen ads between games.

AdMob may collect and use the advertising ID, device and app information, approximate location from the IP address, ad interactions, and its own diagnostics, to serve, measure and limit ads, and to prevent fraud. See how Google uses information from apps that use its services. You can reset or delete the advertising ID in your phone's Google settings.
AdMob is the only third party that receives data from this app. {name} does not include Firebase or any other analytics service.

The evening reminder is optional and off until you turn it on. You can turn it on in Settings, or by allowing notifications when the app asks once after your first level win. A phone that allows notifications without asking does not turn it on. While it is on and notifications are allowed, the app schedules at most one local reminder a day, around 7 pm phone time, and none on a day you have already played.

The reminder is made and shown on this phone using Android's notification system. No data is sent for it and no push server is used. You can turn it off at any time in Settings, which cancels the pending reminder, or in your phone's settings.
Daily rewards use the phone's own clock, with checks on the phone that stop a reward being claimed twice when the clock is moved. The app does not contact a time service.

The share card is a picture made on the phone. It holds your chosen name (or none) and your score, never your gender or icon. It leaves the phone only when you tap Share, through your phone's share sheet. The app does not receive the list of people you share with. Vibration only runs when that setting is on.

p: {name} shows Google AdMob ads: rewarded videos that you choose to watch, with a daily cap, and a banner. There are no full-screen ads between games. Ads are limited to content rated PG.

The Google Mobile Ads SDK may collect and use the advertising ID, the IP address (for approximate location), ad interactions, and diagnostics such as crash and performance data, to serve, measure and protect ads and to prevent fraud. See how Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services. You can reset or delete the advertising ID in your phone's settings (Google, then Ads).
AdMob is the only third party that receives data from this app. {name} does not include Firebase or any other analytics service.

When the game starts on Android, it sends an empty request to https://www.google.com/generate_204 and reads only the date and time from the reply, so the daily gift and the Daily Thali follow real time and not a changed phone clock. The request carries no game data, no player details and no ad or device ID. Like any web request, it lets Google see the phone's IP address and the web view's browser string. If the phone is offline, the game falls back to its own clock checks.

Reminders are off until you turn them on (the game asks once after your first Daily Thali, or you can use Settings). The game then schedules at most one local notification a day, around 6 pm phone time, using Android's notification system. The text is made on the phone. Nothing is sent to a server and no push service is used. Turning reminders off cancels the pending one.

The share card is drawn on the phone and leaves it only when you tap Share, through your phone's share sheet. All fonts, pictures and sounds are inside the app, so the game makes no requests to font or art servers.
